mods.name: Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack (14 Unique Maps)
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.tagline: 14 playable levels across Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Paldea — 2 unique maps per region with 3D landmarks.
mods.description: 14 playable levels across Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Paldea — 2 unique maps per region with 3D landmarks.
mods.fullDescription: Standalone regional levels expansion adding all 7 Gen 3-9 regions to PokéBonk's Map Picker with 2 distinct maps each (14 levels total). Every map features its own terrain relief, color palette, weather pool, sanctuary arena, regional encounters, and a dedicated 3D centerpiece landmark. Works completely standalone with vanilla Kanto/Johto Pokémon or paired with National Dex Expansion (Gen 3-9).
highlights: Hoenn: Petalburg Canopy & Mt. Chimney Caldera
Sinnoh: Mt. Coronet Spear Pillar & Eterna Forest Chateau
Unova: Desert Resort Relic Castle & Dragonspiral Tower
Kalos: Azure Bay Sea Arch & Reflection Cave Prisms
Alola: Melemele Tapu Ruins & Wela Volcano Fire Altar
Galar: Galar Wild Area Dynamax Den & Crown Tundra Temple
Paldea: Asado Desert Titan Mesa & Area Zero Terastal Spire
mods.requirements: Offline Mode (Mod Engine ON; works standalone or with National Dex Gen 3-9)

mods.name: Hyrule's Mods (QoL & Cheats Collection)
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.tagline: Offline Mode events hub, live main menu customization, P2P multiplayer, and optional solo cheats.
mods.description: Offline Mode events hub, live main menu customization, P2P multiplayer, and optional solo cheats.
mods.fullDescription: All-in-one Offline Mode Quality-of-Life, Enablers, and Trainer Cheats collection by HyruleChosenOne. Restores past seasonal events in a dedicated Choose-Mode hub without altering your wallpaper or music, unlocks direct IP:Port P2P Co-op multiplayer, and adds live 3D main menu diorama and music selectors alongside optional solo speed/combat cheats and save utilities.
highlights: Events Enabler restoring Lavender Tower Night and Mewtwo Strikes Back in a dedicated hub
Direct IP:Port Peer-to-Peer Co-op multiplayer hosting and joining
Live 3D Main Menu Wallpaper and Music selector (supports additive custom music)
Optional solo Offline cheats (Run Speed 1x/1.5x/2x, God Mode, Overdrive, Unlock All Difficulties, and Trainer Save Utilities)

mods.name: National Dex Expansion (Gen 3-9: Hoenn to Paldea)
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.tagline: Expands the playable Pokédex to #1025 with 419 Gen 3-9 families, 72 custom attacks, and 24 signature Ultimates.
mods.description: Expands the playable Pokédex to #1025 with 419 Gen 3-9 families, 72 custom attacks, and 24 signature Ultimates.
mods.fullDescription: Complete Gen 3 through Gen 9 character and moveset expansion covering Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Paldea (#252-#1025). Adds 419 playable base evolution families, 774 species with animated sprites, 72 custom Gen 3-9 attacks across all 18 types, and 24 custom signature Ultimates for iconic starters, pseudos, and legendaries. Pure Pokémon and attacks pack with zero bundled levels; pair with Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack for regional maps.
highlights: Expands the Pokédex cap from #251 to #1025 across all 7 Gen 3-9 regions
419 playable base families (all starters, fan favorites, Paradox Pokémon, and legendaries)
72 custom Gen 3-9 attacks across all 18 types rendered via PokéBonk's native GPU VFX engine
24 custom Ultimates (Rayquaza, Lucario, Garchomp, Greninja, Zacian, Koraidon, Miraidon, Raging Bolt, Terapagos, and more)
Characters start locked by default for progression, with per-generation unlock tools in Unbound Settings

mods.name: Custom & Non-Dexed Pokémon Pack (18 Fighters)
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.tagline: 18 playable Non-Dexed, Glitch, Beta, Spin-Off, and Mega/Primal Pokémon including MissingNo., Shadow Lugia, Primal Dialga, Bad Egg, Substitute Doll, Beta Arceus, and more.
mods.description: 18 playable Non-Dexed, Glitch, Beta, Spin-Off, and Mega/Primal Pokémon including MissingNo., Shadow Lugia, Primal Dialga, Bad Egg, Substitute Doll, Beta Arceus, and more.
mods.fullDescription: Expands the core Custom region (#2000-#9999) with 18 fully animated playable fighters: 13 iconic Non-Dexed, Glitch, Beta, and Spin-Off legends (MissingNo. with animated Gen 1 glitch sprites and DMG-Green Shiny, Substitute Doll, Bad Egg, Shadow Lugia XD001, Primal Dialga, Shadow Mewtwo, Eternal Flower Floette, Ultra Necrozma, Beta Arceus, Purple Kecleon, Mikon Beta Vulpix, Pikachu Libre, and Hakogame Beta Turtle) plus 5 Special Forms (Mega Rayquaza, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, Mega Mewtwo X, and Ash-Greninja). Every fighter includes 8-direction animations, portraits, signature custom attacks with Core Custom VFX, and custom Ultimates.
highlights: Glitch & Oddity icons: MissingNo. (#2011, with custom animated glitch sheet & DMG-Green Shiny), Substitute Doll (#2012), and Bad Egg (#2013)

Spin-Off & Unreleased legends: Shadow Lugia XD001 (#2014), Primal Dialga (#2015), Shadow Mewtwo (#2016), Eternal Flower Floette (#2017), Ultra Necrozma (#2018), Beta Arceus (#2019), Purple Kecleon (#2020), Mikon (#2021), Pikachu Libre (#2022), and Hakogame (#2023)
Special Forms: Mega Rayquaza, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, Mega Mewtwo X, and Ash-Greninja
37 signature custom attacks, 15 custom GPU VFX presets, 18 custom Ultimates, and 5 custom Pokéball pickup items
Drop-in ./characters/ folder support — runs natively via the Core Modding API (no separate enabler mod required)

mods.name: Gen 1&2 Soundtrack
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.tagline: 43 classic Kanto & Johto music tracks (FRLG, HGSS & GB Sounds) plus 6 iconic SFX added alongside every vanilla song.
mods.description: 43 classic Kanto & Johto music tracks (FRLG, HGSS & GB Sounds) plus 6 iconic SFX added alongside every vanilla song.
mods.fullDescription: Expanded additive Gen 1 & Gen 2 Pokémon soundtrack and sound effects mod curated from FireRed/LeafGreen, HeartGold/SoulSilver, and authentic 8-bit GB Sounds archives. Registers 10 nostalgic menu themes, 20 battle/route/dungeon themes into the in-game music rotation, 13 legendary & champion boss themes into the boss pool, and 6 classic SFX stings — all without overwriting or removing a single vanilla PokéBonk track.
highlights: 10 selectable main menu themes: Title Screen (FRLG & HGSS), Pallet Town, New Bark Town, National Park, Route 1, Route 29, Goldenrod, Ecruteak & Cerulean City
20 in-game battle & dungeon themes: Wild, Trainer, Gym Leader, Rival, Team Rocket, Rocket Hideout, Silph Co., Victory Road, Pokémon Tower, Battle Tower & GB Sounds classics
13 legendary & champion boss themes: Mewtwo, Legendary Birds, Deoxys, Champion Blue/Lance/Red, Ho-Oh, Lugia, Raikou, Entei, Suicune, Frontier Brain & Super-Ancient
6 short iconic SFX clips (Level Up, Item Get, Heal, Caught, Badge Get & Evolution) routed through PokéBonk's native SFX slider
100% additive — every vanilla PokéBonk song remains selectable and intact

mods.name: Link (The Minish Cap) — Playable Character & Custom Attacks
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.tagline: Playable Link from The Minish Cap with 8-direction sprites, 5 custom attacks, dedicated custom VFX, and Four Sword Ultimate.
mods.description: Playable Link from The Minish Cap with 8-direction sprites, 5 custom attacks, dedicated custom VFX, and Four Sword Ultimate.
mods.fullDescription: Brings Link from The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap into PokéBonk as a fully animated playable fighter in the Custom region (#2010). Features complete 8-direction walk, idle, attack, and hurt spritesheets, a Four Sword Red shiny variant, 5 signature Minish Cap custom attacks built with the Core Custom VFX engine, a custom Four Sword Hurricane Spin Ultimate, and 2 Hyrule Pokéball pickup items.
highlights: Full 8-direction GBA-style animated spritesheet plus Four Sword Red shiny variant
5 custom attacks: Picori Blade, Magical Boomerang, Gust Jar, Cane of Pacci, and Flame Lantern
5 custom GPU VFX presets showcasing dual-color slash arcs, returning crescents, gale waves, magic beams, and flame rings
Custom Ultimate: Four Sword Hurricane Spin with rune/petal shockwaves and slash bursts
2 custom Pokéball items: Gold Kinstone and Pegasus Boots
